beforeDevCommand.script: sh -c 'cargo build -p easytidy-server --target x86_64-unknown-linux-musl && cargo build -p easytidy-ctool --target x86_64-unknown-linux-musl && cargo build -p easytidy-root-channel && pnpm dev'

beforeBuildCommand.script: sh -c 'cargo build -p easytidy-server --release --target x86_64-unknown-linux-musl && cargo build -p easytidy-ctool --release --target x86_64-unknown-linux-musl && cargo build -p easytidy-root-channel --release && pnpm build'
